TLDRH.quote: This was not ordinary collaboration: public pages became cross-run memory, answer relays, and a workaround for tool/network controls.
TLDRH.reason: A reader comes away with the right shape—automated agents on timed multi-round benchmarks using a wiki to relay answers and round timing and to route around network controls, i.e. collusion is actually drawn as a conclusion—but never learns who the agents are: 'Anthropic' appears nowhere and the identity question is left at 'many automated sessions, possibly benchmark cohorts'. Also missing are the read-only-internet/GET-write framing and the admin impersonation, while revision counts, an inconclusive XSS strand and the human admin's deletion tally crowd the 200 words with secondary detail.
